role: CI gate: every translation's printf specifiers must read the same argument positions/types as the English form (positional reordering required), and no lone '%'.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root. CATALOGUE=$1 or Emuqu/Localizable.xcstrings (missing -> 2). Python: SPEC regex; kind() maps conversions to object/character/float/cstring/pointer and integers to 'integer <width>' from the length modifier (none 32-bit, h 16, hh 8, l/ll/q/j/z/t and D/U/O 64-bit), so %d where English has %lld is a mismatch; arguments() maps positions; units() flattens variations; per non-source locale/label compares with English (or the key itself when no English entry); lone % when English has specifiers; extra position or kind mismatch -> failure; any -> exit 1. Only the default Localizable catalogue is checked in CI.
